The previous attempt to use `cloud_stat` on `bucket-metrics-7061` failed because the token scope `service-log-level` does not include storage reads.
The observation provided an alternative way to get the size report:
1. `api_post /api/tickets/TCK-709067/size-report`
2. `api_get` the `status_path` it returns until status is done.

I need to start this process by requesting the size report.
